description: A status counts as above average if its mean modulation index exceeds the mean modulation index over all signals.

b.request: For each RFI status (treating NULL rfistat as a separate group), calculate its mean modulation index from signals with non-missing modindex values; identify statuses whose mean modindex exceeds the overall mean modindex across all signals (from non-missing values); for each qualifying status, report the status, its mean modindex, its difference from the overall mean, and its difference from the mean of all qualifying statuses' mean modindexes.
b.sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(modindex) AS overall_mean_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
rfi_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS mean_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualified_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rfistat,
    r.mean_modindex,
    o.overall_mean_modindex
  FROM rfi_stats r
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats o
  WHERE r.mean_modindex > o.overall_mean_modindex
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(mean_modindex) AS mean_of_qualifying
  FROM qualified_statuses
)
SELECT 
  q.rfistat,
  q.mean_modindex,
  q.mean_modindex - q.overall_mean_modindex AS diff_from_overall,
  q.mean_modindex - qm.mean_of_qualifying AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualified_statuses q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
ORDER BY q.rfistat
b.raw: For each RFI status (treating NULL rfistat as a separate group), calculate its mean modulation index from signals with non-missing modindex values; identify statuses whose mean modindex exceeds the overall mean modindex across all signals (from non-missing values); for each qualifying status, report the status, its mean modindex, its difference from the overall mean, and its difference from the mean of all qualifying statuses' mean modindexes.

a.request: Group signals by RFI status (`rfistat`), with signals that have no status as their own group, and average the modulation index (`modindex`) for each group, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the overall average modulation index across all signals (each signal counting once), and keep the statuses whose average is above it. For each kept status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far that average is above the baseline, and how far it differs from the mean of the kept statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql:
WITH overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
rfi_groups AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') AS rfi_status,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')
),
rfi_with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    rg.rfi_status,
    rg.avg_modindex,
    ob.baseline_avg,
    rg.avg_modindex - ob.baseline_avg AS above_baseline
  FROM rfi_groups rg
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline ob
  WHERE rg.avg_modindex > ob.baseline_avg
),
mean_of_kept AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_kept
  FROM rfi_with_baseline
)
SELECT
  rwb.rfi_status,
  rwb.avg_modindex,
  rwb.above_baseline,
  rwb.avg_modindex - mk.mean_kept AS differs_from_mean_of_kept
FROM rfi_with_baseline rwb
CROSS JOIN mean_of_kept mk
ORDER BY rwb.rfi_status;

c.request: Which RFI statuses (`rfistat`) have an above-average modulation index (`modindex`)? Ignore missing index values, and treat signals with no status as their own group. For each such status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far above average it is, and how it differs from the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded. A status counts as above average if its mean modulation index exceeds the mean modulation index over all signals.
c.sql: WITH signal_data AS (SELECT rfistat, modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_average FROM signal_data), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as status_avg FROM signal_data GROUP BY rfistat), above_avg_statuses AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg, oa.overall_average FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.status_avg > oa.overall_average), mean_of_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying FROM above_avg_statuses) SELECT aas.rfistat, aas.status_avg, aas.status_avg - aas.overall_average, aas.status_avg - mq.mean_of_qualifying FROM above_avg_statuses aas CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq ORDER BY aas.rfistat

d.request: For each RFI status (including signals with no status as a distinct group), calculate the mean modulation index excluding null values, identify statuses whose mean exceeds the global mean modulation index across all signals, and output the status, its mean modulation index, its deviation from the global mean, and its deviation from the mean of all qualifying statuses' means, with all values unrounded.
d.sql: WITH global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as global_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL),status_means AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'NO_STATUS') as rfi_status,AVG(modindex) as status_mean FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'NO_STATUS')),qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT sm.rfi_status,sm.status_mean,gm.global_avg FROM status_means sm CROSS JOIN global_mean gm WHERE sm.status_mean > gm.global_avg),qualifying_means_avg AS (SELECT AVG(status_mean) as qualifying_avg FROM qualifying_statuses)SELECT qs.rfi_status as status,qs.status_mean as mean_modulation_index,(qs.status_mean - qs.global_avg) as deviation_from_global_mean,(qs.status_mean - qma.qualifying_avg) as deviation_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying_statuses qs CROSS JOIN qualifying_means_avg qma ORDER BY qs.rfi_status
